# v0.2.0 — Modular Excel and CSV toolkit

2026-09-08 (UTC) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/yyyz1011/sheetdelta/releases/tag/v0.2.0)

## Changes

Modular Excel and CSV data APIs. Documentation language and theme controls moved to the top navigation.

## Installation and upgrade

Install this version:

```sh
npm install sheetdelta-core@0.2.0
```

Review the [migration guide](../migration) and [related usage guide](../imports) before upgrading. This is a summary of released changes, not a claim of support for every Excel feature.
